headline: Mulholland's shutout backed by Jordan's walk-off single
recap: Terry Mulholland and Giants starter Kelly Downs traded zeros into the bottom of the ninth, still scoreless when Lenny Dykstra led off with a double, his 26th of the season. Tom Herr singled him to third, and after reliever Craig Lefferts intentionally walked Von Hayes to load the bases, John Kruk grounded into a force play at the plate that retired Dykstra but left the bases loaded with one out. Ricky Jordan then lined a single to right off Steve Bedrosian, scoring Herr and handing the Phillies a 1-0 win.

Mulholland went the distance, allowing just two hits and two walks over nine innings with four strikeouts for the complete-game shutout. Downs matched him for eight scoreless innings on five hits and a walk before departing, and was charged with the loss when Herr -- his inherited runner -- scored the winning run off Bedrosian.

Philadelphia managed only five other hits off San Francisco's staff before the ninth and stranded five runners along the way, with Jordan's one-out RBI single in the finale enough to make Mulholland's outing stand up.
